notes: Boutiques by region: not found. The FY26 Annual Report and Non-Financial Report 2026 give only group totals (2,376 boutiques in the Richemont network, 1,393 directly operated) and no regional split, so no boutique rows were recorded. Employees by region come from the Non-Financial Report 2026 (headcount at end of March 2026, total 40,465; the FY26 column has no scope exclusion note, while FY25 excluded YNAP, Gianvito Rossi, Manufacture Miles and Vhernier); Japan is a reporting region that is a single country, so it is a country row. The table's last region is now named Middle East, India, Africa & Türkiye; regions are not defined by a country list in that table. No U.S. state data or taxes-by-country report was found. Regional headquarters are from the current Global presence page (re-read 2026-11-24); the registered office is from the FY26 Annual Report; the Cartier Valenza site keeps its FY25 Annual Report description.
